mechanism: Native mixed quantization with one Euclidean/hyperbolic weight per codeword, allocated from the TRAIN structural density of the items each codeword covers

calls.name: mixed cost of one joint codeword
calls.note: The continuous surface is unchanged from the F0 recipe: the cost the assignment is taken over, with the curved codeword already mapped into the ball. What this mechanism changes is where the scalar weight comes from -- a per-codeword table instead of a per-item table -- not the formula. The two-dimensional width is a slice of the sixteen-dimensional halves; the formula is dimension-free.

coupling.note: The codeword table enters the cost matrix as a [K] vector broadcast over the batch, so two codewords can be scored with different weights in the same forward pass. A constant table is arithmetic-identical to the per-item path; the measured counterexample for the weight's effect is the same as F0's: with a Euclidean cost of [1, 4] and a curved cost of [4, 1] the weight 1/4 picks the second code and 3/4 the first.
